summary: The Storm Developer designs, implements, and maintains Apache Storm topologies for processing real-time streaming data efficiently and reliably.
responsibilities: Develop Storm topologies for data ingestion, processing, and analytics
Optimize performance, resource utilization, and fault tolerance
Integrate Storm with Kafka, HDFS, or databases
Collaborate with data engineers and analysts

education: 3–5 years of experience with Storm or similar frameworks

skills_required.name: Understanding of distributed and parallel processing
Knowledge of real-time data processing patterns
